candidates.change_summary: Replace the require that msg.value == 1 ether with require(msg.value >= 1 ether) allowing larger ether to be accepted and changing recorded behavior when callers send more than 1 ether.
Change the requirement that the sender has no existing guess from == 0 to != 0, flipping the guard so only addresses with an existing guess can call successfully.
Insert a statement that sets the stored guess before checking msg.value, so state is written even if the payment requirement fails.
Delete the line that sets guesses[msg.sender].block, leaving only the guess bytes stored and not recording the future block number.
Replace block.number + 1 with block.number, changing which block is recorded for settlement.
Move the assignment of guesses[msg.sender].guess to after setting the block, swapping the order of writes.
Replace the comparison that checks block progression from '>' to '>=' so settle can run in the same block as the locked-in block.
Move the state-clearing assignment guesses[msg.sender].block = 0 to after the potential transfer, so block field remains set during transfer and comparison.
Replace computation of answer to use only the block number (no blockhash), altering the comparison value.
Replace the require guarding contract balance before transfer with a different amount (1 ether), allowing transfer when only 1 ether is available.
